faq.q: How long does the boat transfer from Marbella to Sotogrande take?
faq.a: The journey from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande Marina typically takes 45 to 60 minutes, covering about 25 nautical miles. Depending on sea conditions and the boat you choose, you can arrive in time for a morning tee-off or an afternoon round.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a golf transfer?
faq.a: For a small group (up to 9 pax), the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are cost-effective at €749/2h. For larger parties (up to 12 pax), the Mangusta 80 at €4,719/4h includes a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: Can I book a return transfer on the same day?
faq.a: Yes, same-day return is standard. You can arrange a pick-up time after your round. The boat will wait at Sotogrande Marina or return to collect you. Minimum charter duration is 2 hours, so a round trip fits easily.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

faq.q: Do I need to bring my own golf clubs?
faq.a: You can bring your clubs on board – there is ample storage on all our boats. Just let us know in advance so we can ensure space. Caddies or trolleys can also be accommodated.

faq.q: Can I combine the transfer with a boat rental for the whole day?
faq.a: Absolutely. Many golfers charter the boat for 8 hours: transfer to Sotogrande, play 18 holes, then enjoy a sunset cruise back. The Astondoa 40 costs €2,299/8h, while the Mangusta 80 is €4,719/4h (add extra hours on request).

faq.q: What golf courses are near Sotogrande Marina?
faq.a: Sotogrande Marina is minutes from Valderrama (host of the 1997 Ryder Cup), La Reserva Club, Almenara, and Sotogrande Club de Golf. All are within a 10-minute taxi ride from the marina.

faq.q: How do I book a golf transfer by boat?
faq.a: Contact us via WhatsApp on our website. Provide your group size, preferred date, and desired boat. We’ll confirm availability and send a booking link. Payment secures the charter.

data.body_html:
For 2027, the most stylish way to reach Sotogrande’s world‑class golf courses is by private boat from Marbella. A direct transfer from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande Marina takes just 45–60 minutes – no traffic, no tolls, just a chilled cruise along the Costa del Sol. With a licensed skipper, drinks, and snacks included, you arrive relaxed and ready to tee off.

Why take a boat to Sotogrande for golf?

Driving from Marbella to Sotogrande can take over an hour in summer traffic. By boat, you skip the AP‑7 tolls and the frustration of finding parking. The journey covers 25 nautical miles of coastline, passing Estepona, the Sierra Bermeja mountains, and the exclusive villas of the Golden Mile. You step off at Sotogrande Marina, a 5‑minute taxi ride from Valderrama, La Reserva, Almenara, and Sotogrande Club de Golf.

Our fleet for golf transfers

We offer two tiers of boat for your transfer. All depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA.

For other boats (e.g., Ferretti 94, Canados 86, Maiora 26m), pricing is on request via WhatsApp.

Sample itinerary: morning round from Marbella

  • 08:00 – Meet at Puerto Banús, board your chosen boat.
  • 08:15 – Depart, enjoy coffee and pastries as we cruise south.
  • 09:00 – Arrive Sotogrande Marina. Taxi to Valderrama (5 min).
  • 09:30 – Tee off.
  • 14:00 – Return to Sotogrande Marina. Boat departs for Marbella.
  • 14:45 – Back in Puerto Banús, with time for lunch or a swim.

You can also extend the day: charter the boat for 8 hours (€2,299 with the Astondoa 40) and add a sunset cruise after your round.

Golf courses near Sotogrande Marina

Sotogrande is home to some of Europe’s finest courses. All are within a short taxi ride from the marina:

  • Valderrama – Ranked among the world’s top 50 courses. Host of the 1997 Ryder Cup and the Andalucía Masters.
  • La Reserva Club – A 27‑hole Sotogrande resort course with ocean views.
  • Almenara Golf – 18 holes designed by Dave Thomas, with a driving range and academy.
  • Sotogrande Club de Golf – The original 18‑hole course, opened in 1964.

All courses welcome visitors, but we recommend booking tee times in advance – especially during peak season (May–October).

What to bring on your boat transfer

  • Golf clubs (stored in the cabin or on deck – let us know in advance)
  • Sun protection (hat, sunglasses, SPF 50+)
  • Light jacket or windbreaker (sea breeze can be cool in the morning)
  • Swimwear if you want to dip off the boat on the way back
  • Camera or phone for the coastal views

Our boats are equipped with fresh towels, shade, and a cool box with drinks. You don’t need to bring anything else.

How to book your 2027 golf transfer

Booking is simple. Contact us via WhatsApp with your group size, preferred date, and boat choice. We’ll confirm availability and send a payment link. A 50% deposit secures the charter, with the balance due 48 hours before departure. For last‑minute bookings (within 48 hours), full payment is required.

We recommend booking at least one week in advance for popular summer dates. For groups of 8 or more, consider the Mangusta 80 – it includes a free jet ski for after‑golf fun.
